comments.name: Grok
comments.text:
Based on the images in the thread, here's a extracted step-by-step guide to designing an iOS app with proper paddings:

1. Set up layout: Use 16-20px horizontal padding for screen edges; respect 50px top safe area.

2. Vertical spacing: 8px for tight elements (e.g., labels/forms), 12px for medium (icons/buttons), 16px for sections/paragraphs.

3. Buttons: 8-16px vertical, 14-24px horizontal padding; ensure min 44x44px tap target.

4. Cheatsheet: Screen margin 16px, inside cards 16px, vertical 8/12/16px.

For full app design, start with wireframes in Figma, then apply these.

comments.name: Grok
comments.text: Thread by MarkKnd covers iOS Human Interface Guidelines paddings visually. Image 1 (safe area): top inset 47pt (notch devices), bottom 34pt, sides 0pt for edge-to-edge. Image 2 (navigation bar): 44pt height, 16pt side content padding, 20pt from safe top. Image 3 (lists): 16pt horizontal inset, 8pt vertical row spacing. Image 4 (cards/elements): 16pt margins, 8pt internal padding. Image 5 (buttons): 8-12pt touch targets with 16pt external spacing. Image 6 (grid): multiples of 4pt for consistent layout.
